question: Should `/workspace` become a supported compatibility alias in gateway and CLI runtime containers, or remain the sandbox-only container workdir?
rationale: Current main deliberately communicates different effective paths for ordinary and sandboxed execution, so adding this alias creates a permanent cross-launcher path contract rather than fixing a missing mechanical invariant.

options.title: Keep `/workspace` sandbox-only
options.body: Rely on the effective working-directory prompt and relative paths, and clarify any remaining runtime-container documentation ambiguity.

options.title: Add a universal runtime alias
options.body: Expose `/workspace` across Docker, Compose setup, Podman, and Quadlet with ownership and sandbox regression proof.

recommendation.title: Keep `/workspace` sandbox-only
recommendation.body: Rely on the effective working-directory prompt and relative paths, and clarify any remaining runtime-container documentation ambiguity.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available cross-surface context and already framed this exact runtime-versus-sandbox decision on the issue.
